Search.heading: Search {edition}
Search.refused: Try a longer or less common word.
Search.semanticUnavailable: Semantic search is not available right now.
Search.tooMany: Too many searches; try again in a minute.
Search.empty: Type a word, a theme or a reference to search this edition.
Search.refusedQuestion: Try other words for that theme or idea.

placeholders.keyword: Words in the verse, e.g. shepherd
placeholders.semantic: A theme or idea, e.g. trust in God

Search.unreadableReference: That reference could not be read. Try one like {example}.
Search.compareLater: Only {edition} is shown: the compared editions will be matched verse by verse once the verse mapping is ready.
Search.partialReference: Part of that reference could not be read; the rest is shown below. Try one like {example}.

help.keyword: Finds the verses that contain the words you type, in the edition's own language. Tick “Exact phrase” to find those words together, exactly as written.
help.semantic: Finds verses about a theme or idea even when they say it in other words: synonyms and paraphrases work well, and so does a word in another language (“nemico” finds “enemy” in an English edition).
help.reference: Shows exactly the verses of a Bible reference, such as Jonah 1:1-2:2; 3:2, using the book names and notation of your language.
